details.what: the fox looking up at him

description:
A foggy wooden pier at night. A tall rusty robot lighthouse keeper, about 2 metres, stands holding a glowing lantern in his right hand. A small red fox sits on top of a wooden crate beside him, looking up at him. Next to them are a brass telescope on a tripod and a big coil of thick rope.

The robot speaks slowly in a deep, tired voice: "Storm is coming, little one. Stay close to the light."
The fox answers in a quick, cheeky voice: "You say that every night."
Then the fox gives a short yip.

Sounds: waves slapping against wood, a far-away foghorn, creaking planks, and seagulls. Music: a slow, lonely accordion tune that feels a little hopeful.
